items.title: Deputy Treasurer
items.description: About MoonPay MoonPay is for builders with something to prove. This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend. 30M+ customers and 500+ ecosystem partners run on us. Licensed in the U.S. Regulated across the UK, EU, Canada, and Australia. AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters. You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together. The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building for what's next, for humans and agents. Recent recognition: Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers 2026 . 2nd in Crypto Services on Fortune's inaugural Crypto 100 The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running Research has shown that women are less likely than men to apply for this role if they do not have experience in 100% of these areas. Please know that this list is indicative, and that we would still love to hear from you even if you feel that you are only a 75% match. Skills can be learned, diversity cannot. About the Opportunity As Deputy Treasurer you will report to the Treasurer, serving as their senior counterpart and shaping and executing MoonPay's treasury strategy as the business continues to scale. You will play a critical role across regulatory expansion, liquidity and capital management, treasury reporting, and trading-related activities. This is a high-impact role requiring strong financial judgment and the ability to operate effectively in a complex, fast-moving environment. You will work across Finance and other key functions to ensure MoonPay has the liquidity, capital structure, controls, and treasury capabilities required to support its strategic ambitions and expansion into new markets. What you will do Partner closely with the Treasurer to develop and execute MoonPay's treasury strategy, translating company priorities into effective liquidity, capital, risk, and treasury plans. Lead liquidity and capital management activities, including forecasting requirements, optimizing deployment of capital, and identifying emerging constraints or opportunities. Support regulatory and geographic expansion by assessing treasury implications, capital and liquidity requirements, banking considerations, and relevant regulatory requirements (e.g., NYDFS trust company and payment stablecoin frameworks, GENIUS Act, FFIEC reporting, state money transmitter/BitLicense regimes). Oversee treasury analysis, scenario modelling, and reporting, translating liquidity, capital, and risk data into clear recommendations for senior stakeholders. Provide senior oversight of trading-related treasury activities, including counterparty risk assessment across OTC and exchange trading relationships, applying disciplined risk management and financial analysis to decision-making, execution, and performance. Build scalable treasury infrastructure, controls, processes, and external partnerships that enable MoonPay to operate effectively as the business grows in scale and complexity. About You You have 7+ years of experience in treasury, financial services, fintech, payments, digital assets, banking, or another highly regulated and financially complex environment, including at least 2 years of experience working with digital assets or stablecoins. You have hands-on experience with digital asset treasury operations, including stablecoin reserve management, custody and wallet considerations, and exchange or on-chain counterparty risk. You bring advanced expertise in liquidity and capital management, treasury risk management, forecasting, and scenario analysis, with experience navigating complex and high-impact decisions. You have strong knowledge of financial regulation, particularly across banking, payments, money transmission, or digital asset and stablecoin frameworks, and experience evaluating the treasury implications of regulatory or market expansion. You have demonstrated the ability to influence senior and cross-functional stakeholders while operating with significant autonomy and ambiguity, balancing competing priorities, challenging assumptions, and building scalable approaches. Salary: $180,000 - $300,000 (based on state, and experience level) Research has shown that women are less likely than men to apply for this role if they do not have experience in 100% of these areas. Please know that this list is indicative, and that we would still love to hear from you even if you feel that you are only a 75% match. Skills can be learned, diversity cannot. items.title: Cilvēkresursu OPS biznesa partneris(-e)/ HR Business Partner for Operations
items.description: HR biznesa partneris Operacionālajā jomā, kas nodrošina visaptverošu personāla vadības atbalstu, stiprina organizācijas kultūru un atbalsta vadītājus efektīvu lēmumu pieņemšanā un komandu vadībā. Pienākumi: Darboties kā galvenajai HR kontaktpersonai Operacionālajās funkcijās, sniedzot praktisku atbalstu vadītājiem un veicinot efektīvu lēmumu pieņemšanu. Atbalstīt darbinieku iesaistes un organizācijas kultūras attīstības iniciatīvas. Nodrošināt kvalitatīvu darbinieka dzīves cikla procesu īstenošanu (atlase, ievadīšana darbā, attīstība, snieguma vadība, darba attiecību izbeigšana) un pilnveidot procesus. Konsultēt vadītājus darba tiesību un darba attiecību jautājumos, pārvaldīt sarežģītus gadījumus un nodrošināt atbilstību normatīvajiem aktiem. Analizēt personāla datus, identificēt riskus un sadarboties ar vadību darbaspēka plānošanā un noturēšanā. Sadarboties ar HR komandām un, pēc nepieciešamības, iesaistīties svarīgu amatu atlases procesos. Apmācīt un attīstīt vadītāju kompetences personāla vadībā un līderībā. Vadīt un koordinēt darba attiecību gadījumus, nodrošinot atbilstošu dokumentēšanu. Identificēt darba attiecību riskus un ieteikt to mazināšanas pasākumus. Piedalīties HR procesu pilnveidē un starpfunkcionālos projektos. HR Business Partner within Operations who provides comprehensive HR support, strengthens organizational culture, and enables managers to make effective decisions and lead their teams. Responsibilities: Act as the main HR point of contact for Operations, providing practical support to managers and enabling effective decision-making. Support employee engagement and organizational culture development initiatives. Ensure high-quality delivery of employee lifecycle processes (recruitment, onboarding, development, performance management, off-boarding) and drive process improvements. Advise managers on labor law and employee relations matters, manage complex cases, and ensure compliance with regulations. Analyze HR data, identify risks, and collaborate with management on workforce planning and retention. Collaborate with HR teams and support recruitment for key roles as needed. Coach and develop managers’ capabilities in people management and leadership. Lead and coordinate employee relations cases and ensure proper documentation. Identify employee relations risks and recommend mitigation actions. Contribute to continuous HR process improvement and cross-functional projects. Prasības: Augstākā izglītība personāla vadības (HR) vai līdzīgā jomā; 2–3 gadu pieredze personāla vadības vai ar darbiniekiem saistītā amatā (vēlams vadītāja pieredze); Pieredze Operacionālajā vadībā; Zināšanas par darba tirgu, darba tiesību pārzināšana; Personīgās kompetences: spēja saskatīt organizācijas kopējo ainu un saprast, kā struktūrvienība iekļaujas šajā sistēmā; spēja strādāt ar cilvēkiem un caur cilvēkiem; pašmotivācija; orientācija uz rezultātu; Teicamas latviešu un angļu valodas zināšanas mutvārdos un rakstiski darba pienākumu veikšanai -darbam ar uzņēmuma iekšējām sistēmām un ikdienas saziņai ar citiem starptautiskajiem departamentiem; Augsta līmeņa datorprasmes. Expectations: Higher education within areas of HR or similar; 2–3 years of experience in HR or people-related role (preferably managerial experience); Experience within Operations; Expertise in labor market, knowledge of labour law; Personal competencies: an ability to see The big picture of the organization and how the departmental unit fits into that structure; an ability to work with and through people; self-driven; results-oriented; Excellent spoken and written Latvian and English languages for performing job duties - working with the company's internal systems and daily communication with other international departments; Advanced computer literacy.

items.title: Sales Development - ANZ
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. ABOUT THE ROLE As a Sales Development Representative (SDR) based in Australia, at ElevenLabs you will play a crucial role in building an effective outbound sales strategy, whilst working closely with the Account Executives. We don’t just sell a product or custom-level solutions; we are partnering with enterprises to help them generate new experiences and monetisation opportunities at scale with our breakthrough voice technology. In this role you will: - Conduct research to identify potential leads and prospects within the target market. - Engage in outbound activities such as cold calling, emailing, and social media outreach to initiate contact with potential customers - Implement personalized and effective outreach campaigns to maximize lead conversion. - Collaborate closely with the Account Executive to exchange insights on prospect feedback, objections, and market trends. - Continuously refine and adjust outreach strategies based on the feedback loop. - Monitor and report key performance indicators (KPIs) related to outbound sales activities, including conversion rates, lead quality, and outreach effectiveness. - Collaborate with the sales leadership to analyze data and optimize strategies for better results. REQUIREMENTS - 2-3 years outbound B2B sales experience with a track record of securing new business meetings. - Demonstrated ability to build Opportunity sized lead lists in new markets and categories - Experience with full suite of prospecting tools - Demonstrated ability to build, scale process - Demonstrated ability to nurture a team - Curiosity - asking insightful questions and developing solutions from a foundation of knowledge and insight. - Self-motivated, thriving as part of a team while possessing the ability to stay driven and proactive independently. - Effective time management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and manage a high volume of leads. - Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. #LI-remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

items.description: About Easygo Easygo is a founder-led, Melbourne-based entertainment company, one of Australia's fastest-growing. Are you a passionate and ambitious Staff Software Engineer ready to dive into an environment that fosters innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth? We're seeking talented individuals who are eager to tackle complex problems, build scalable solutions, and collaborate with some of the finest engineers in the entertainment industry. Complex Projects, Creative Solutions : Dive into intricate projects that challenge and push boundaries. Solve complex technical puzzles and craft scalable solutions. Accelerate Your Growth : Access mentorship, training, and hands-on experiences to level up your skills. Learn from industry experts and gain expertise in scaling software. Collaborate with Industry Leaders : Work alongside exceptional engineers, exchanging ideas and driving innovation forward through collaboration. Caring Culture, Career Development : We deeply care about your career. Our culture prioritises your growth with tailored learning programs and mentorship. Embrace Challenges, Celebrate Success : Take on challenges, learn from failures, and celebrate achievements together. Shape the Future : Your contributions will shape the future of entertainment. If you're passionate about growth, innovation, and working with the best, we'd love to have you on our team! Optimise existing systems for performance, scalability, and reliability, identifying and resolving bottlenecks and inefficiencies. Experience with modern tech stacks (ideally JavaScript / Go, Docker , Cloud services e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and related technologies. Proficient in JavaScript fundamentals, Design Patterns, Subscriptions WebSockets, Pub/Sub), TypeScript and related technologies. Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. Strong understanding of code architecture, design principles and documentation practices. Analytical mindset to address complex technical challenges and devise innovative solutions. Experience providing technical leadership, mentoring, and guiding teams. Strong communication skills for effective collaboration with teams and stakeholders. Positive attitude and eagerness to learn new technologies to grow as a Lead engineer. Preferred Qualifications: Experience as a Staff or Principal Software Engineer in a large-scale product company. Experience building web applications and debugging production applications. Experience with CI/CD tools (e.g., AWS Code Pipeline, Github Actions) for automating the deployment process. Some of the perks of joining us: Championing Engineering Excellence to influence cultural change across the organisation. Work alongside the top 5% of engineering talent in Australia using a vast cloud native tech stack including AWS, Microservices, Large-Scale Distributed Systems, K8's, Go, Terraform, Typescript, Svelte, GraphQL, Nodejs and React. Exposure to building global, large-scale volume products which operate at thousands per second frequency. EAP access for you and your family Access to over 9,000 courses across our Learning and Development Platform Paid volunteer day Team lunches every Monday. Fun office environment with table tennis and all your favourite gaming consoles. Unlimited snacks and drinks provided. We believe that the unique contributions of everyone at Easygo are the driver of our success. To make sure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience we never discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. We are passionate about providing a workplace that encourages great participation and an equal playing field, where merit and accomplishment are the only criteria for success.

items.location_text: San Francisco, Seattle, New York, Toronto
items.description: Who are we? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! Why this role? Cohere is in a unique and exciting position to grow our go-to-market teams globally! We are expanding our Talent Team and are looking for a creative, high-performing Talent Attraction and Employer Brand Specialist to help us build a world-class employer brand that attracts top frontier AI talent. In this role, you will shape how Cohere is perceived by the global AI community and drive strategic recruitment marketing initiatives that position us as the destination for ambitious researchers and engineers. Please Note: We have offices in Toronto, San Francisco, and London but embrace being remote-first! As a Talent Attraction and Employer Brand Specialist, you will: - Develop and execute comprehensive brand strategy that defines and promotes Cohere's identity, culture, and technical leadership to target talent groups - Run multi-channel recruitment marketing campaigns across social media, job boards, and search engines to reach priority candidates - Create compelling content including job descriptions, employee success stories, and optimized career site landing pages - Optimize and maintain our career site experience while tracking engagement through candidate relationship management tools - Analyse campaign performance metrics including cost-per-hire, application conversion rates, and ROI to continuously refine our approach - Partner with Marketing, Communications, and Research teams to ensure consistent messaging across all candidate touchpoints - Monitor competitor employer branding strategies and identify opportunities to differentiate Cohere - Collaborate with hiring teams to develop targeted recruitment campaigns for specific roles and departments About you; - You have demonstrable (6+ years) experience in employer branding, recruitment marketing, or talent attraction - You have a proven track record of developing and executing successful multi-channel campaigns - You're skilled in content creation with portfolio examples of compelling job descriptions and employee narratives - You have experience with candidate relationship management tools and career site optimization - You're data-driven with experience tracking and analyzing recruitment metrics - You're creative and strategic, able to balance brand consistency with campaign innovation - You're passionate about AI/ML and understand the talent landscape in this field - You're collaborative with excellent cross-functional partnership skills - You're comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving startup environment FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS: - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. - Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. HOW AND WHERE WE WORK: - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs. We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider. Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

items.title: Virtual Events Manager
items.description: Perplexity is revolutionizing how companies get work done. We are seeking a Virtual Events Manager to build the channel that shows people what our products can do and teaches them how to use them. You will develop a deep working knowledge of our products, turn that knowledge into compelling live experiences, and own the programs that convert audiences into active users and qualified pipeline. This role has two sides. You are a charismatic host and product storyteller who can command a virtual room, and you are the operator who keeps every event on the rails. You will find and prepare the right experts from across Perplexity, work with Growth to build the audience, and measure whether each program produced a real business return. If you have a passion for understanding how things work, thrive in taking something complex and making it engaging, and want to build a world-class virtual events engine from the ground up, this role is for you. RESPONSIBILITIES - Know the product cold. Develop a deeper working knowledge of our products than anyone else in events, using new features as they ship, building the workflows yourself, and staying close to the teams that built them. - Own virtual events end to end. Run the channel from program strategy and calendar planning through event briefs, speaker staffing, rehearsals, live production, follow-up, and retros. Build a reliable portfolio of onboarding programs, product launches, feature deep-dives, customer conversations, and use-case workshops. - Bring the product to life. Host, moderate, present, and demonstrate the product live with energy and clarity. Turn complex capabilities into specific, accurate stories that audiences can understand and put to work. - Find and prepare the right people. Build relationships across Product, Engineering, Research, Sales, Customer Success, Partnerships, and Marketing to identify the strongest speakers and subject-matter experts for each program. Brief them thoroughly, sharpen their stories, and make sure they are ready to deliver. - Build the audience. Partner with Growth, Lifecycle, Social, Comms, Sales, and Customer Success on full-funnel promotion plans that drive qualified registrations. Track pacing closely, identify gaps early, and run experiments across audience, creative, channel mix, timing, and follow-up. - Turn every event into an engine. Extend the value of each program through recordings, replays, clips, FAQs, demo flows, education materials, and sales follow-up. Build formats and templates that make the next event faster and better. - Measure outcomes, not just outputs. Instrument the funnel from registration through attendance, engagement, product activation, qualified pipeline, and revenue. Track cost per registration, cost per attendee, cost per qualified attendee, sourced and influenced pipeline, and channel ROI, then use the findings to improve the portfolio. - Build the operating system. Create the intake process, master calendar, production checklists, run-of-show templates, speaker bench, readiness gates, contingency plans, scorecards, and reporting cadence required to scale the channel without lowering quality. QUALIFICATIONS - 3+ years of experience in virtual events, product marketing, customer education, demand generation, or a related role, ideally within a high-growth technology company, or work that proves the skill regardless of title. - Proven ability to learn technical products deeply and translate complex capabilities into simple, specific, and accurate live demonstrations. - A polished, credible on-camera presence, with experience hosting, interviewing, moderating, or presenting to professional audiences. - Strong cross-functional instincts and the ability to find, recruit, brief, and coordinate busy experts without relying on formal authority. - Full-funnel growth fluency, including registration strategy, audience segmentation, campaign testing, conversion, and post-event nurture. - Analytical rigor, with experience defining channel metrics, working with CRM and marketing automation data, and calculating return on investment. - Excellent production judgment and attention to detail, including rehearsals, technical readiness, live moderation, and fallback planning. - High slope: you learn unfamiliar products and domains fast, and your rate of improvement is your standout trait. - Extreme comfort delivering clarity in high-velocity, ambiguous environments.

items.location_text: San Francisco, Seattle, New York, Toronto
items.description: Who are we? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! Why this role? Cohere is in a unique and exciting position to grow our go-to-market teams globally! We are expanding our Talent Team and are looking for a dedicated Early Careers & Interns Specialist to help us build a world-class pipeline of future AI talent. In this role, you will design and execute comprehensive early careers programs that attract, develop, and retain top student and recent graduate talent, positioning Cohere as the premier destination for ambitious early-career professionals in AI. As an Early Careers & Interns Specialist, you will: - Design and implement strategic early talent programs with clear goals for intern and graduate pipelines - Own for end-to-end recruitment process for hundreds of interns per year globally. - Align with early careers frameworks with Cohere's global growth plans and talent needs - Story tell the comprehensive learning objectives and core projects for each intern cohort - Build and maintain partnerships with top universities and colleges to source high-potential candidates - Develop targeted employer branding strategies specifically for student markets - Represent Cohere at career fairs and host on-campus recruitment events - Partner with the People team to execute seamless Intern onboarding and orientation experience - Establish and manage mentor/buddy pairing systems for new starters - In partnership with the People team, conduct regular progress check-ins, assess overall engagement and oversee performance reviews for interns - Consider the full life cycle of the intern experience, from onboarding through to internship completion/long term retention - Track key program metrics including conversion rates, retention, and ROI - Gather and analyze feedback from managers and interns to continuously improve program effectiveness - Manage budgets, logistics, and scheduling for all early careers initiatives - Consider the evolution of an intern program, such as ours, as we scale. What works well today versus what will break and need iteration as we double in size? About you; - 5+ years of experience in global early careers, internships, or graduate recruitment with a focus on technical roles - Expertise in international university partnership development and global campus recruitment for STEM fields - Demonstrated experience building inclusive and equitable Intern programs with excellent project management skills and exceptional attention to detail - Commitment to talent development and exceptional, inclusive early-career experiences - Proven ability to track and analyse program metrics data - Innovative approach to developing learning objectives and project frameworks - Strong collaborative skills with excellent communication abilities - Comfortable working across diverse stakeholder groups and locations WHY COHERE - Impact: Shape the future of AI talent at a cutting-edge company. - Culture: Collaborative, innovative, and mission-driven. - Growth: Join a team scaling from 800 to 2000+ over 18 months. If some of the above doesn't line up perfectly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply! If you consider yourself a thoughtful worker, a lifelong learner, and a kind and playful team member, Cohere is the place for you. We value and celebrate diversity and strive to create an inclusive work environment for all. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form, and we will work together to meet your needs. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. HOW AND WHERE WE WORK: - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider. Our Operations group ensures that every product moves seamlessly from concept to customer — integrating supply chain strategy, manufacturing operations, and quality systems to enable rapid, reliable, and scalable production. We partner closely with engineering, design, and manufacturing teams around the world to deliver exceptional products at launch and beyond. About the Role As an Operations Manager, you will own the execution and strategy that transforms early product concepts into high-quality, manufacturable consumer devices. You’ll lead cross-functional planning, manage vendor relationships, and ensure supply, cost, and schedule alignment across fast-moving hardware programs. This role is based in Singapore. We follow a hybrid model (four days per week in the office) and offer relocation support for new employees. Occasional travel to supplier and manufacturing sites is expected. In this role, you will: - Develop and execute operations strategies that bridge product design and large-scale manufacturing. - Drive build readiness and production planning from prototype through mass production. - Partner with global suppliers to ensure materials, tooling, and capacity meet program goals. - Collaborate with hardware, quality, and supply chain teams to establish and maintain robust operational systems. - Track cost, yield, and schedule performance to ensure efficient and predictable product delivery. - Build scalable processes that support rapid iteration and future product launches. items.title: Solutions Engineer, UK
items.description: About Glean: Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles. At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level. Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality. If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more - deeply embedded where people get things done. You’ll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company. About the Role: The Solution Engineer role sits within the GTM organisation within the UK&I region, making you a trusted technical advisor to the local sales team, our partners, and our customers. You will work on many exciting projects with some of the most future-forward organizations, helping to guide the beginning of their Generative AI journeys. This role has a strong technical skillset and not a classic SE profile. At Glean, our Solution Engineers work with our customers to help them connect Glean to their most important decision-making platforms. These platforms include Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Jira, Confluence, Slack, GitHub, Zendesk, and everything in between! As an SE, you will work closely with our local Account Executives (AEs) and will be responsible for the technical success and delivery of our sales opportunities. You will: Performing interactive demonstrations of the Glean platform to prospective customers. Educating the technical teams of our prospective customers on the architecture of the Glean platform. Specifically, articulating the “how” of how our solution works in the context of the customer landscape. Scoping and executing sponsored pilot and Proof of Value (PoV) exercises to ensure the technical requirements and business objectives that the Glean solution provides are validated. Educating and training our customers and partners on our product to ensure that they are set up for success. Presenting at company-sponsored events such as Google Cloud Next and AWS re: invent. Liaising with Glean product managers and engineers to investigate issues, raise feature requests, and understand our future roadmap. About you: You will have a bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent work experience). At least 5+ years of experience in enterprise software pre-sales and have used value-based discovery frameworks. You possess excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to handle complex technical challenges. You are able to explain complex technical concepts in layman’s terms to help educate and train our customers, prospects, and partners. You are comfortable presenting, both virtually and in person. Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (IaaS) platforms such as GCP, AWS, and Azure. Familiarity with identity services and Single Sign-On (SSO) providers such as Azure/Entra ID, Okta, and protocols such as SAML, SCIM, and OIDC. Familiarity with APIs, including sending and receiving data from API endpoints, and how to troubleshoot issues. Familiarity with security concepts and tools, e.g. Firewalls, VPNs, SSL/TLS, DLP, WAFs, and proxies. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive compensation, Medical, and Dental coverage, generous time-off policy, and the opportunity to contribute to your pension plan to support your long-term goals. We’re committed to building and sustaining a diverse, inclusive workplace. We strive to attract and retain people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we do not discriminate on the basis of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race. #LI-HYBRID #LI-HYBRID AI-First Mindset at Glean: At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page https://www.kraken.com/culture to understand what drives us and how we work. THE TEAM Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. Payward is hiring a HR (People) M&A Lead to own the people side of our M&A activity end to end — from first-pass diligence through close and integration. Reporting directly to our CPO, this is a high-pace, high-volume seat that needs someone who thrives on fast turnarounds and incomplete information. We're looking for an in-house operator with an analyst's mindset who can use AI to move fast through messy data rooms, but whose real edge is judgment — knowing what risks matter and when to deviate. THE OPPORTUNITY - Own the people's workstream of Payward's M&A activity end to end — from first-pass diligence through close and integration. - Build and own People due diligence questionnaire (DDQ) including data requests and questions to the target, follow-ups and deeper-dive workshops. - Crunch high-volume, low-structure data rooms — employment contracts, org data, comp and equity files, policies, claims history — using AI and automation to compress review cycles. - Filter signal from noise: translate hundreds of findings into a short list of flags scored against Payward's risk tolerance, with a clear recommendation attached to each. - Lead the drafting of the people-side deal mechanics: comp modelling, equity treatment, retention and earn-out structures, and deal-specific considerations that hold up in negotiation with founders. - Sit in the room with corp dev, legal, finance and People leadership — leverage SMEs and push recommendations upward, defending them with data. - Act as People M&A program manager during integration after signing: support org design, levelling and comp harmonization, retention execution, and Day 1 people readiness. - Turn each deal into reusable infrastructure and learnings — playbooks, DDQ templates, risk scoring, and automation that make the next deal faster. WHAT YOU BRING - 8+ years across M&A people/HR diligence, integration, total rewards, or corp dev — with hands-on ownership of the people workstream on completed deals. - A track record of running multi-diligence processes in tandem, to a hard timeline: knowing what to prioritize or defer. - Strong analytical depth — comfortable modelling comp, equity, dilution, retention cost and integration spend directly, not briefing someone else to do it. - Global/cross-border deal experience with multi-jurisdiction and/or regulatory change of control employment considerations. - Demonstrated use of AI and automation to review large document volumes, with judgement about where the model's output can and cannot be trusted. - Ability to make and communicate risk calls on incomplete information, and to state a position clearly to executive stakeholders. - Credibility in founder-facing negotiation conversations on comp, equity and retention structures. - Rigorous confidentiality instincts and comfort operating on live, undisclosed transactions. - High agency in ambiguity — deals move, scope shifts, and no one hands over a finished process. NICE TO HAVES - Crypto, fintech or regulated financial services acquisition experience. - Experience integrating founder-led or early-stage teams into a larger platform. - Prior work building a diligence or integration playbook from scratch. items.title: Manager, Technical & Operational Accounting
items.description: About the Team OpenAI Finance is responsible for ensuring the organization is set up for success in pursuit of its mission. The Technical Accounting, Accounting Policy, and Financial Reporting organization partners across Finance to assess complex corporate matters and develop well-supported U.S. GAAP conclusions. The team supports non-routine business activities requiring thoughtful technical judgment, scalable accounting policies, financial statement disclosures, processes, and controls. About the Role You will partner closely with Technical Accounting, Financial Reporting and Controllership to translate complex accounting conclusions into scalable operational procedures. You will build processes for non-standard transactions, including warrants, equity-method investments, debt and equity securities, non-controlling interests, hypothetical liquidation at book value allocations, business combinations, and other complex financing, investment, and capital arrangements. You will advise stakeholders across Corporate Accounting, Financial Reporting, Treasury, Legal, Tax, Strategic Finance, FP&A, Equity, Internal Controls, valuation specialists, and external auditors. You will help resolve complex accounting questions, align leaders on material judgments and risks, and translate conclusions into audit-ready memoranda, close entries, disclosures, processes, and controls. This is a highly visible role for an accounting professional who can turn technical conclusions into practical execution, support non-routine transactions through recurring close processes, and strengthen operational accounting across Finance. In this role, you will: - Own operational accounting for complex financing, investment, equity, and capital arrangements, including classification, measurement, presentation, disclosure, and recurring close processes. - In partnership with technical accounting, lead day-one and recurring accounting for non-standard transactions, including fair-value measurements, equity-method investments, debt and equity securities, warrants, noncontrolling interests, and hypothetical liquidation at book value allocations. - Perform reconciliations for assigned accounts, investigate discrepancies, and drive issues to resolution. - Support the resolution of complex accounting matters during monthly and quarterly close. Ensure conclusions are reflected in financial statement presentation, footnote disclosures, journal entries, reconciliations, ownership, and controls. - Build operational processes to assess impairment indicators and asset recoverability for goodwill, intangible assets, long-lived asset groups, equity-method investments, nonmarketable equity investments, and debt securities, as applicable. - Coordinate valuations for non-standard transactions with Technical Accounting and valuation specialists. - Lead audit support for assigned investments and other complex accounting areas. Prepare evidence-backed schedules, memoranda, reconciliations, valuation support, and financial statement tie-outs. - Analyze significant equity and other compensation awards, and partner with Equity Administration and Controllership to ensure accurate, timely accounting and booking. - Coordinate with Tax on downstream impacts without owning tax conclusions. - Partner with Financial Reporting and Internal Controls to strengthen controls, SOX/ICFR readiness, impairment monitoring, audit trails, tie-outs, and subsequent-event procedures. - Monitor emerging accounting standards and translate new guidance into policies, implementation plans, disclosures, reporting calendars, and scalable processes. - Participate in cross-functional initiatives involving accounting-policy implementation, operating-model changes, legal-entity matters, and systems or process improvements. - Develop pragmatic accounting policies, playbooks, decision frameworks, and automation that improve consistency, strengthen capability, preserve judgment, reflect economic substance, and escalate unresolved issues. You might thrive in this role if you: - Hold a CPA, CA, or equivalent accounting qualification, or bring comparable demonstrated technical-accounting expertise. - Bring 5+ years of progressive experience in technical accounting, accounting advisory, public accounting, corporate controllership, or complex financial reporting, with meaningful industry or transaction experience. - Demonstrate broad U.S. GAAP expertise across corporate accounting, financial instruments, consolidation, business combinations, equity-method investments, debt and equity securities, impairment, fair value, financial statement presentation, and complex ownership structures. - Apply relevant guidance across ASC 320, 321, 323 326, 350, 360, 470, 480, 718, 805, 810, 815, and 820; and other applicable guidance as the facts require. - Have developed or reviewed audit-ready technical memoranda, implemented conclusions in recurring operations, worked constructively with external auditors, and grounded conclusions in evidence, economic substance, and authoritative guidance. - Have experience with significant aspects of close and reporting, acquisitions or investments, complex ownership structures, consolidation, or impairment assessments. Understand how technical decisions affect journal entries, reconciliations, disclosures, and controls. - Understand how accounting policies and judgments flow into close, financial statements, disclosures, reconciliations, significant estimates, treasury activity, and external-reporting readiness. - Set priorities across consequential workstreams and raise the bar for inclusive, scalable accounting practices while protecting financial reporting integrity. - Have experience with Oracle Fusion Accounting Hub, accounting rules engines, automated subledgers, ERP implementations, or similar source-to-general-ledger systems. items.title: Field Marketing Manager
items.description: Great products grow when people experience their value firsthand. We are looking for a Field Marketing Manager to design and scale programs that turn in-person engagement into enterprise pipeline. You will manage a full range of third-party sponsorships and Perplexity-led field events that drive awareness, deepen relationships with senior buyers, and accelerate opportunities. You will join a small field marketing team as an equal partner, working together to divide the portfolio based on company priorities, capacity, geography, and each person's strengths. This is a hands-on role for someone who can set the strategy and execute every detail. You will work closely with Sales, Product Marketing, Growth, Partnerships, and Customer Success to identify the right audiences, build programs around their needs, and turn each event into measurable business impact. The ideal candidate is a field marketing generalist who is equally comfortable evaluating a sponsorship, building a regional plan, hosting an executive dinner, working a conference floor, and analyzing pipeline conversion afterward. You may bring deeper experience in sponsored events or owned programs, but you should be ready to operate across both. RESPONSIBILITIES - Co-own the field marketing strategy. Work as an equal partner on a two-person field marketing team to build the portfolio around company priorities, target accounts, sales territories, product launches, and pipeline goals. Divide and conquer across programs while maintaining shared standards, visibility, and accountability. - Turn field engagement into pipeline. Design every program around a clear audience, business objective, conversion path, and follow-up plan, from pre-event outreach through opportunity creation and deal acceleration. - Own third-party event sponsorships. Evaluate conferences and sponsorship opportunities, recommend where Perplexity should invest, negotiate and activate packages, coordinate speakers and on-site presence, and build the pre-event and post-event motion required to produce a return. - Run high-impact Perplexity events. Own executive dinners, vertical roundtables, regional roadshows, customer workshops, and hackathons that build pipeline and deepen relationships with senior buyers. - Align tightly with Sales. Partner with Account Executives, SDRs, and Sales leadership on target-account lists, meeting goals, outreach, on-site roles, hand-raiser routing, and post-event follow-up. - Represent Perplexity in the market. Lead on-site execution across conferences and owned events, including messaging, booth or venue experience, executive participation, customer meetings, and post-event conversion. - Build integrated campaigns around field moments. Work with Product Marketing, Growth, Lifecycle, Social, Comms, and Partnerships to extend events through targeted outreach, content, digital programs, and sales activation before and after each moment. - Own execution end to end. Manage agencies, vendors, venues, budgets, timelines, run-of-show, staffing, production, and contingency planning while maintaining a high bar for attendee experience. - Measure outcomes, not activity. Instrument the path from invited account through registration, attendance, meeting, opportunity, and revenue. Track cost per attendee, meetings held, target-account engagement, sourced and influenced pipeline, deal acceleration, and program ROI. - Build the field operating system. Create the planning cadence, intake process, event tiers, checklists, reporting, and retros required to scale the program and make investment decisions based on results. QUALIFICATIONS - 5+ years of experience in field marketing and event marketing, ideally in B2B SaaS or enterprise technology. - Proven track record building and scaling a portfolio that includes third-party sponsorships, conferences, and company-led field programs, with measurable pipeline or deal-acceleration results. - A versatile, hands-on operator who can move between strategy, sponsorship evaluation, campaign planning, event production, executive management, on-site execution, and performance analysis. - Deep expertise in either third-party sponsorships or company-led field events is welcome, provided you have the range and interest to operate across both. - Strong event planning and execution skills, with experience managing both intimate executive programs and larger conferences, roadshows, or customer events. - Collaborative and low-ego, with experience working alongside a peer to divide a large portfolio, make tradeoffs, share context, and step into each other's programs when needed. - Excellent relationship builder who can engage senior executives, customers, prospects, Sales teams, vendors, and cross-functional partners with equal ease. - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to craft compelling event narratives, executive briefs, and field campaign plans. - Analytically rigorous, with experience setting targets, managing budgets, working with CRM data, and reporting sourced and influenced pipeline. - Highly organized, resourceful, and calm under pressure, with the judgment to solve problems quickly when plans change on site. - Willingness to travel frequently for event management and field activations.

items.location_text: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Anthropic's services partner ecosystem is a critical channel for bringing Claude to enterprise customers worldwide. This ecosystem spans the full spectrum of services firms — from global system integrators and the world's largest consultancies, to specialist and regional SIs, to our growing cohort of AI-native boutique partners. Together, their reach, vertical depth, and delivery capacity are essential to scaling Claude's enterprise footprint. Managing this breadth well requires rigor, repeatability, and a team that can drive meaningful joint outcomes across a portfolio of partners that differ widely in scale, operating model, and maturity. We're looking for a Head of Partner Management & Ecosystem BD to lead the team of Partner Account Managers responsible for the full range of our services partnerships and to develop and execute commercial strategies for the ecosystem in partnership with Sales. You'll coach and develop a team of PAMs, shape the operating model for how we engage each segment of the ecosystem, and build the programs, playbooks, and measurement systems that let us scale with quality. You'll work closely with partnerships leadership, sales, product, and customer success to ensure our partners are equipped to win and deliver transformative AI solutions for their clients. The commercial side of this role is as important as the team-leadership side. Working hand in hand with Sales leadership, you'll define where and how partners create revenue for Anthropic — which partners we co-sell with in which accounts and industries, how partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline is built and forecast, and what a joint account plan looks like when both sides own the number. You'll develop new ways of going to market, while also managing the tri-party motion with our cloud service partners and tech company partnerships, so that a services partner, a cloud platform, and Anthropic show up to a customer as one coordinated offer rather than three separate conversations. This role sits at the intersection of team leadership, partner strategy, and operational execution. You'll stay close enough to the work to engage directly with partner leadership when it matters, while investing most of your time in making your team and the broader ecosystem more effective over time. Key responsibilities Lead, coach, and develop a team of Partner Account Managers covering Anthropic's services partners, from global SIs and consultancies through to AI-native boutique partners Set clear expectations, goals, and operating standards; hold the team accountable to partner revenue, pipeline, and program outcomes Hire and retain exceptional talent; build a team culture grounded in rigor, partnership, and care for Anthropic's mission Develop and execute commercial strategies for the partner ecosystem in partnership with Sales — defining joint account plans, co-sell priorities by segment and industry, and pipeline and revenue targets that both organizations own Develop new ways of going to market, while also managing the tri-party motion with our cloud service partners and tech company partnerships Build the rules of engagement between PAMs and account teams: how partners are brought into deals, how sourced and influenced pipeline is attributed and forecast, and how conflicts are resolved Identify and launch new partner-led routes to market — industry solutions, packaged offerings, marketplace transactions — and prove them out with a small set of partners before scaling across the portfolio Own the ecosystem's contribution to the revenue plan; report on partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, bookings, and consumption to partnerships and sales leadership Shape the operating model for each segment of the ecosystem: how PAMs plan with partners, run QBRs, forecast, track partner health, and prioritize their time across a portfolio Design engagement models that fit the partner — executive-level, multi-threaded relationships with global SIs alongside scalable, programmatic coverage for boutique and regional partners Partner with the broader SI program to adapt tier structure, benefits, and requirements to partner dynamics Build and evolve playbooks that help PAMs recruit, onboard, activate, and grow partners consistently Work with enablement, product, and solutions teams to ensure partners have the training, certifications, and technical resources they need to build and deliver production-grade Claude solutions Identify gaps in partner readiness, drive cross-functional investment to close them, and ensure consistent quality of partner engagement across the team Collaborate with sales, partner operations, marketing, We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. items.title: Product Designer, Social
items.location_text: Bellevue, WA; Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY
items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. The Social team at Robinhood is building the products that help customers share, discover, and connect around their financial journeys — bringing transparency and community to personal finance in a way that has never been done before. We sit at the intersection of product, engineering, data science, and content to create experiences that are as intuitive as they are engaging. Our team moves fast, experiments constantly, and holds the bar high for both craft and impact. We care deeply about understanding our users, and we design with empathy, rigor, and a shared belief that great design makes financial access more equitable! As a Product Designer on the Social team, you'll own end-to-end design of social and community features across Robinhood's consumer mobile app — from initial concepts through polished, shipped product. You'll partner closely with product managers, engineers, data scientists, and researchers to shape how millions of customers discover, share, and engage with financial content. You'll translate ambiguous problems into clear, considered design solutions and contribute to the ongoing evolution of Robinhood's design system. This is a meaningful opportunity to help define what community-driven investing looks like on mobile at scale. This role is based in our Bellevue, WA; Menlo Park, CA; and New York, NY office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you’ll do Design end-to-end experiences for social and community features on Robinhood's consumer mobile app, from early-stage exploration through delivery Partner with product managers, engineers, and data scientists to define problems, explore solutions, and ship high-quality product Conduct user research and usability testing to validate concepts and inform design decisions throughout the product process Create wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs that clearly communicate your intent across all stages of development Contribute to and help evolve Robinhood's design system, raising the bar for consistency and craft across the app Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, brand, and content teams to create cohesive, end-to-end user experiences Present work to stakeholders and incorporate feedback thoughtfully and efficiently What you bring 3+ years of product design experience, with a strong portfolio of shipped work on consumer mobile products (iOS and/or Android) Demonstrated experience designing social, community, or content-driven features within a mobile app context Strong proficiency in Figma and experience working within and contributing to design systems Ability to move fluidly between strategic thinking and high-quality visual execution Experience working closely with engineering, product, and research teams throughout the full product development cycle Clear, confident communication skills — you can articulate your design decisions, present work effectively, and give and receive feedback well Comfort navigating ambiguity and driving clarity in fast-moving, iterative environments A portfolio that reflects strong interaction design, visual craft, and a user-centered process What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds. Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not. Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application. Robinhood provides equal opportunity for all applicants, offers reasonable accommodations upon request, and complies with applicable equal employment and privacy laws. Inclusion is built into how we hire and work—welcoming different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences so everyone can do their best. items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. The Customer Experience Engineering team at Robinhood sits at the intersection of cutting-edge AI and real human impact. We build the systems that power how millions of customers get support — from intelligent chatbot deflection and ticketing tools to a first-of-its-kind private wealth product called Concierge, designed for high-net-worth customers. Our team of engineers spans iOS, Android, web, backend, and LLM/AI specializations, working closely with dedicated product managers and data scientists to ship products that set a new bar in the fintech space. We move fast, we iterate, and we take quality seriously. As the Senior Engineering Manager for Agent Experience, you'll own the engineering execution of one of Robinhood's most ambitious and high-visibility zero-to-one products. You'll lead a team of engineers building premium, AI-powered features — natively within the Robinhood app for our highest-value customers. This role requires a leader who is comfortable navigating ambiguity, aligning closely with product leadership, and delivering reliably in a fast-moving environment with executive visibility. You'll be a key voice in shaping both the technical direction and the culture of this team! This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA office, with in-person attendance expected 5 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What You'll Do Lead and develop a high-performing engineering team of ~15, owning hiring, performance, and career development across the full stack (iOS, Android, web, backend, and LLM/AI) Partner closely with product managers and data scientists to define and execute the Concierge product roadmap, from initial scoping through launch Drive delivery of complex, zero-to-one product features — including AI-powered financial planning tooling Navigate ambiguity and product direction changes with clarity and composure, maintaining team focus and momentum through shifting priorities Represent the engineering team in executive-level discussions, communicating progress, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to senior leadership and the C-suite Establish proactive quality measures, reliability standards, and engineering best practices suited to a high-risk, customer-facing product Champion a culture of accountability, technical excellence, and continuous improvement within your team What you bring 8+ years of software engineering experience, with 3+ years in an engineering management role leading teams of 10 or more Demonstrated track record leading user-facing product development, ideally in consumer fintech, wealth management, or a high-stakes customer experience domain Experience building or scaling zero-to-one products, including navigating high ambiguity and frequent direction changes Strong cross-functional partnership skills — you've worked closely with product managers to define roadmaps and translated business goals into clear engineering plans Comfort presenting to and engaging with senior leadership and C-suite stakeholders, including managing expectations in high-visibility settings Proven ability to build and maintain service reliability standards and proactive quality practices on consumer-grade systems Familiarity with LLM/AI systems, or experience working alongside teams building AI-powered features Excellent communication skills — written and verbal — with the ability to create clarity from complexity Nice to have: Experience in regulated financial products or familiarity with wealth management offerings (tax, estate planning, etc.) Background in both platform/infrastructure and product engineering, enabling strong technical breadth across the stack Experience supporting a team through organizational transitions or leadership changes Leadership Expectations Our ambitious roadmap requires a great culture shaped by exceptional leaders. Here's what we expect from them: Drive high performance by setting clear, focused goals, giving real-time feedback, stretching top talent, and scaling impact through focus, dedication, and technology. Hire and retain top talent by setting a high bar, hiring only those who raise it, investing in onboarding, and addressing talent issues quickly and fairly. Create community by connecting work to purpose, removing friction while prioritizing safety, building trust and inclusion, and leading from the front with integrity. Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not. Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! items.title: Talent Acquisition Specialist , GTM & Corporate - EMEA
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. THE ROLE As a member of the EMEA Talent Acquisition team focused on Corporate and Go-To-Market hiring, you will be instrumental in building and scaling Mistral's EMEA-based teams across both corporate functions and revenue-generating roles. Joining early means you'll help shape our recruitment strategy and operations, partnering closely with leaders across Corporate functions (Finance, Legal, People, Operations, Marketing, Communications) and GTM functions (Sales, Pre-Sales/Solutions, Partnerships, Customer Success, and Revenue Operations). Your work will directly influence Mistral's commercial and operational success by ensuring we find and engage exceptional operators who will drive Mistral's growth across the EMEA region. In this role, you'll also foster a strong candidate experience and help establish recruiting best practices as we expand across multiple EMEA markets. WHAT YOU WILL DO STAKEHOLDER PARTNERSHIP - Partner deeply with Corporate and GTM leaders — from CRO and VP Sales to Finance, Legal, and People leadership — to understand hiring needs, define role specs, and identify the right talent across multiple EMEA markets. - Own full-cycle recruitment across Corporate and GTM functions: Sales, Finance, Legal, People/HR, Marketing, and Communications roles. - Advise hiring managers on market mapping, leveling, comp positioning, and the competitive landscape for EMEA talent, accounting for local market nuances, benchmarking, and statutory differences across countries. - Translate the nuances of each role into compelling, accurate, and locally relevant candidate outreach. END-TO-END RECRUITMENT - Own the full recruiting lifecycle from sourcing to close, operating with autonomy on complex, high-volume roles across Corporate and GTM. - Source passive and active candidates across EMEA talent pools, particularly in AI/ML, open-source software, enterprise infrastructure, and regional corporate markets. - Conduct intake and calibration sessions with hiring managers to align on ideal candidate profiles and stage expectations. - Drive efficient, high-conversion pipelines and close candidates in a fiercely competitive market for senior talent across multiple geographies and languages. - Navigate cross-border hiring complexity, including relocation, remote-friendly offers, and country-specific employment frameworks. CANDIDATE EXPERIENCE & SELLING MISTRAL - Guide candidates through the hiring process with clear communication and a compelling narrative about Mistral's mission, culture, and trajectory. - Articulate Mistral's positioning in the AI landscape — frontier models, open-weight philosophy, and enterprise credibility — to differentiate us against better-known competitors. - Provide candidates with real insight into our GTM motion, corporate operations, growth plans, and the specific impact of their role. - Deliver a high-quality, respectful candidate experience at every stage, regardless of outcome. RECRUITING OPERATIONS & DATA-DRIVEN IMPROVEMENT - Develop and refine recruiting processes, tools, and documentation to improve outcomes and efficiency. - Use data to diagnose pipeline issues (e.g., drop-off at specific stages, time-to-fill by role, offer acceptance rates) and propose targeted solutions. - Build and maintain market maps, competitive intel, and talent pools for key EMEA Corporate and GTM segments. - Standardize interview rubrics, scorecards, and debrief practices across EMEA hiring teams, while respecting local market and language differences. RAISING THE BAR - Collaborate with Corporate and GTM leadership and the broader Talent team to continuously elevate our hiring standards. - Contribute to defining and evolving our EMEA talent acquisition strategy as we scale from early team to a mature, multi-region organization. - Partner on employer-brand and outbound sourcing initiatives that position Mistral as a destination for top Corporate and GTM talent in EMEA. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 6+ years of recruiting experience, including 2+ years in a startup or high-growth B2B SaaS/infrastructure company, with a focus on Corporate functions and/or Sales/GTM roles. - Demonstrated ability to independently hire across the full GTM stack — from Enterprise AE’s to GTM leadership — as well as key Corporate functions (Finance, Legal, People, Marketing, Operations). - Deep network and sourcing expertise in EMEA talent markets, particularly in AI/ML, open-source, developer tools, or enterprise software. - Track record of hiring in competitive, candidate-scarce markets where candidates have multiple offers, including cross-border and multi-language hiring. - Experience working across multiple EMEA markets and comfort with country-specific comp, benefits, and employment nuance. - Willingness to work on other roles as needs come up. - Comfort navigating ambiguity and switching between strategic planning and hands-on execution. - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence peers and senior stakeholders without direct authority. - Organized, detail-oriented, and able to juggle shifting priorities across a high-volume hiring slate spanning two function families. - Professional experience with modern recruiting tools such as Ashby. - Familiarity with the AI/ML landscape and the ability to credibly discuss frontier model capabilities with technical GTM and corporate candidates. WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. PRIVACY POLICY Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

They must have armies of agents and workers who can constantly work in millions of small ways. Repeat. For curious people this is a cycle that never ends.
